notes: The first change-typed run: a chain-only workflow:change node dispatched under the cockpit driver, and the run the change type dir exists for. Its five nodes (standards-discovery, change, verify, change-approval, close-out) live under the frozen workflow: block with node_summaries beside it, the change-approval gate is answered via file by the dispatching operator, and close-out carries the declared change_outcome. Artifacts keep the A4 layout - implementation/work-log.md, which is on the A5 exempt list and carries no summary block, and verification/verification-report.md, which is A5-registered and opens with one. The close-out is the branch where no pull request is required: the dispatch declared pr_required false, so the run ends on a commit and a push. Synthetic rather than sampled: the run it describes is the shape a dispatched change run writes, built to the same schemas the sampled runs are held to, with no absolute path belonging to anyone.
